Presented by As AI models improve, you might expect the market will consolidate around a handful of providers. But user data tells a different story. Among OpenRouter customers spending at least $100 a month, the median number of AI model families in use has doubled over the past year , from three to six. Even as AI models become more capable, businesses are using more models, not fewer. This makes sense when you consider that intelligence isn’t one-dimensional. A model that’s exceptional at writing code may not be the fastest at answering customer questions, or the most economical at processing millions of documents. The question is shifting from “which AI model should we build on?” to “which model should handle each task?” The answer, increasingly, is ‘it depends.’ Which is great for flexibility, less great for simplicity. OpenRouter, which recently joined Stripe , allows businesses to access and govern hundreds of models with the flexibility to optimize for cost, performance, and reliability as the market evolves. Learn more at openrouter.ai . This week’s Sharp Tech is on Jensen’s Not Coming Back, Adventures in Agentic Commerce, Q&A on United, GTA VI, iPhone Duo .
